info.name: Canton Network Credentials and DID demos
info.description: Seeded Credentials and DID GET examples plus separate Canton JSON Ledger API v2 auxiliary contract reads and explicitly opt-in contract writes. Run the Ledger folder on its own after seed; writes are skipped unless ledgerWritesEnabled=true. Cross-stack agreement remains independently opt-in. See postman/README.md. DID discovery roots are descriptors, not credential records; no BFT reader calls.

item.name: Registry list and capture first registry

exec: pm.test('registry page', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.environment.set('registryId', body.items[0].registryId); });

item.name: Alice name credential and capture subject Party

exec: pm.test('Alice seeded credential', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.credentialId).to.eql('urn:demo:name:alice.canton'); const party = body.credential.credentialSubject[0].id; pm.expect(party).to.be.a('string').that.is.not.empty; pm.environment.set('aliceParty', party); });

pm.test('intrinsic record excludes registration', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.credentialId).to.eql('urn:demo:credential:000'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('registration'); pm.expect(b.credential['@context'][0]).to.eql('https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2'); pm.expect(b.credential.type).to.include('VerifiableCredential'); pm.expect(b.credential.issuer).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.canton.anchorers).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test('registered record has separate registration', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.registration.registryAdmin).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.credential['@context'][0]).to.eql('https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2'); pm.expect(b.canton.anchorers).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test('textual issuer with no Party holder or subject is anchored by DemoAnchorer', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.credentialId).to.eql('urn:demo:scenario:external-holderless'); pm.expect(b.credential.issuer).to.eql('did:key:example-issuer'); pm.expect(b.credential.credentialSubject[0]).not.to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(b.canton.holders).to.eql([]); pm.expect(b.canton.anchorers).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(b.canton.anchorers[0]).to.match(/^DemoAnchorer::/); });

item.name: Intrinsic textual issuer with a Party holder stays DemoIssuer

exec: pm.test('a Party holder keeps DemoIssuer as anchorer', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.credentialId).to.eql('urn:demo:scenario:base-credential'); pm.expect(b.credential.issuer).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.canton.holders).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(b.canton.anchorers).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(b.canton.anchorers[0]).to.match(/^DemoIssuer::/); });

pm.test('intrinsic validity remains in the future', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.credentialId).to.eql('urn:demo:scenario:expired-registration'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('registration'); pm.expect(b.lifecycle.state).to.eql('active'); pm.expect(Date.parse(b.credential.validUntil)).to.be.above(Date.now()); pm.expect(b.canton.holders).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(b.canton.anchorers[0]).to.match(/^DemoIssuer::/); });

item.name: Expired registration registered (registration expired, credential valid)

exec: pm.test('registration expiry is independent of intrinsic validity', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.registration.registryAdmin).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(Date.parse(b.registration.expiresAt)).to.be.below(Date.now()); pm.expect(Date.parse(b.credential.validUntil)).to.be.above(Date.now()); pm.expect(b.lifecycleState).to.eql('active'); });

pm.test('snapshot page one', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.length(50); pm.expect(b.hasNext).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.nextPageToken).to.be.a('string').that.is.not.empty; pm.environment.set('credentialNextPageToken', b.nextPageToken); pm.environment.set('credentialSnapshotOffset', String(b.snapshotOffset)); });

pm.test('continued snapshot', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(String(b.snapshotOffset)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('credentialSnapshotOffset')); });
pm.test('holder filter returns a page', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: DSO DID and discovered name services

exec: pm.test('DSO document and name services', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.did).to.match(/^did:canton:DSO::/); pm.expect(b.didDocument.id).to.eql(b.did); pm.environment.set('dsoDid', b.did); pm.environment.set('dsoParty', b.did.slice('did:canton:'.length)); const services=b.didDocument.service; pm.expect(services).to.be.an('array'); for (const [fragment,type,key] of [['name-resolution','CantonDemoNameResolutionService','discoveredResolveUrl'],['reverse-name-resolution','CantonDemoReverseNameResolutionService','discoveredReverseUrl']]) { const s=services.find(x => x.id === b.did+'#'+fragment && x.type === type); pm.expect(s, fragment).to.exist; pm.expect(s.serviceEndpoint.version).to.eql('1.0'); const endpoints=s.serviceEndpoint.endpoints; pm.expect(endpoints).to.have.length(4); const path=fragment === 'name-resolution' ? '/v1/resolve' : '/v1/reverse-resolve'; for (const [index,endpoint] of endpoints.entries()) { pm.expect(endpoint.priority, fragment+' priority').to.eql(index); const base=pm.environment.get(['didBase','didBase2','didBase3','didBase4'][index]); pm.expect(endpoint.uri, fragment+' host '+(index+1)).to.eql(base+path); } const uri=endpoints[0].uri; pm.expect(uri).to.match(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+\/v1\/(resolve|reverse-resolve)$/); pm.environment.set(key,uri); pm.environment.set(fragment === 'name-resolution' ? 'discoveredResolveEndpoints' : 'discoveredReverseEndpoints',JSON.stringify(endpoints)); } });

item.name: 09 OPT-IN cross-stack DID discovery and agreement
item.description: Disabled unless crossStackEnabled=true. Requires BOTH healthy stacks, credentials network localnet, credentials CREDENTIALS_DID_ASSERTIONS_URL set to the DID alias assertion endpoint, and DID cross-stack seed run with ALLOCATED_ALICE_PARTY from the credential seed. Plain DID seed claims only dso.canton. The DSO DID advertises URLs; source=did in the credentials API itself uses configured assertion URL, not this discovery. Bob's DSO self-claim disagrees with Bob's allocation and yields 409 only after the cross-stack fixture has been seeded.

exec: pm.test('cross-stack Alice assertion seeded', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(b[0].subject).to.eql(pm.environment.get('aliceParty')); });

pm.test('DID alias agrees with allocation', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.party_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('aliceParty')); pm.expect(b.fqpn).to.eql('localnet:demo:alice.canton'); });

pm.test('DID reverse agreement', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.some(x => x.party_id === pm.environment.get('aliceParty') && x.fqpn === 'localnet:demo:alice.canton')).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('DID claim disagrees with Bob allocation', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

item.name: Ledger API (writes and auxiliary contracts)
item.description: Run separately after seed: preflight, ACS factory, then selected reads or writes. Writes skip unless ledgerWritesEnabled=true. ACS uses read-only POST despite the request to GET auxiliary contracts. Some snapshots are empty before writes; credential snapshot pages require repeat until nextPageToken is empty. See postman/README.md for order, resume and uniqueness precautions.
